info.name: INYATRI
info.description: InYatri API collection. Set baseUrl (http://localhost:5000). Run Admin Login or Verify Otp for tokens. Self Drive: Mode A browse (optional city_id, 1-day estimate) vs Mode B find (city_id + pickup_at + drop_at).

response.name: Success

item.name: Self Drive
item.description: Self-drive discovery APIs. Mode A = browse with 1-day estimate. Mode B = find with dates.

item.name: List Cities
item.description: List active cities for self-drive. Used before Mode A or Mode B flows.

item.name: Mode A - Browse
item.description: Optional city_id. 1-day estimated pricing. No pickup/drop dates required.

item.name: List Categories (All)
item.description: Browse all car categories with 1-day estimated pricing. No dates required.

query.description: Optional. Filter by city; omit for all cities with 1-day estimate.

response.name: Success

query.description: City ID. Narrows category pricing to this city.

item.name: Checkout And Pay
item.description: Creates booking + PayU session. Dev/local: copy data.payu_redirect_url from response and open in Chrome (do NOT use literal {bookingId}).

item.name: Open PayU (Dev Redirect)
item.description: Dev/local only. Prefer payu_redirect_url from Checkout response. Replace :id with numeric booking id (e.g. 2), never {bookingId}.

query.description: Required in browser. Auto-filled from checkout payu_redirect_url.

variable.description: Numeric booking ID from checkout response data.booking.id
